AI mob animations
=================

The clips AI mobs play (src/main/resources/assets/ntmgunfeel/animations/bot.animation.json) are carried over
from these packs onto Minecraft's six-part humanoid model by tools/quaternius/retarget.py:

  Universal Animation Library and Universal Animation Library 2 by Quaternius
    https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library
    https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library-2
    Idle_Loop, Hit_Chest, Hit_Head, OverhandThrow, Walk_Loop, Jog_Fwd_Loop, Sprint_Loop
  KayKit : Character Animations 1.1 by Kay Lousberg (www.kaylousberg.com)
    https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-character-animations
    Waving, Walking_Backwards, Running_Strafe_Left, Running_Strafe_Right, Ranged_2H_Reload, Death_A, Hit_B

License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0 Universal), public domain dedication
         https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
No credit is required; it is given here with thanks. The clips were changed: turned into Minecraft's part
rotations, keys thinned, and split into upper and lower halves.
